case.assessment_policy: Selected/All use 1 group x 2 builds so the common support-response escape lane is eligible when needed. Theory uses its production lifetime of up to 7 ordinary candidates, including 2 response slots; First and Finish share that budget. Finish follows the first ordinary-verified snapshot. A frozen paired candidate control changes one legal artifact line only; bind engine, rotation, energy, diagnostic seeds and profiles. Production n500 finalists are unseeded. A set/role label is not evidence.

capture.evidence_source: compact.json member array is observed only when parsed; adapter process attempts, launches, failures, and blocks are separate counts

ordinary_measurement.evidence_source: native ordinary-verification receipt; null means absent from retained receipt

support_response.evidence_source: native support_response.check plan/evidence; absent counts remain unknown

progress.clock_kind: UI-observed event-arrival offsets, not engine phase durations

support_stats.response_lane_count_semantics: ordinary finalist candidates selected from the Theory response lane; not support probe calls
